meta_description: Geeky Gardening brings expert garden design and maintenance to Nottingham. Local, reliable, and passionate about your outdoor space. Get your free quote today.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to beautiful outdoor living spaces—we transform gardens across Nottingham with care and creativity.
services_subhead: We handle everything from routine maintenance and hedge cutting to bespoke garden design and landscaping projects—big or small.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Bespoke garden design tailored to your space and lifestyle. We create outdoor rooms that work for relaxation, entertaining, or family play—then build them beautifully.

services.title: Lawn Care & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular grass cutting, scarifying, aeration, and seasonal treatments keep your lawn healthy and green year-round. One-off cuts or ongoing contracts available.

services.title: Hedge & Shrub Trimming
services.desc: Expert hedge cutting and shaping, including overgrown clearance. We keep your boundaries tidy, safe, and looking smart without damaging the plants.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Thoughtful plant selection and installation for borders that flower and colour through all seasons. We choose hardy, low-maintenance varieties suited to Nottingham's climate.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Quick, efficient removal of overgrown beds, dead wood, and garden waste. Perfect for renovating neglected gardens or preparing space for new projects.

services.title: Patio & Decking Work
services.desc: Installation and repair of patios, decking, and garden paths. We use quality materials and proper foundations to ensure they last and look great.

about_pullquote: I started Geeky Gardening because I love solving garden puzzles and making outdoor spaces people actually want to use.
about_para_1: Geeky Gardening has been tending to Nottingham gardens for over 12 years. We started with a simple mission: prove that gardening doesn't have to be complicated or expensive. Whether you're a keen gardener overwhelmed by an overgrown plot or someone who just wants a nice space outside, we listen first, plan carefully, and deliver results.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on reliability, attention to detail, and genuine care for your garden's long-term health. We're local, we show up on time, we clean up properly, and we take pride in the work. Repeat customers are the backbone of our business, and we treat every garden—large or small—as if it were our own.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Our garden was a total mess when we moved in—just weeds and dead shrubs. The Geeky Gardening team came in with a proper plan, cleared everything, replanted with loads of colour, and now we've actually got a garden we use. Really professional, fair price, and they cleaned up after themselves. Brilliant.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Been using them for regular lawn care and hedge cuts for about three years now. Always reliable, always on time, and the garden looks immaculate. Nice bloke to chat with too. Wouldn't go anywhere else.
reviews.author: Jennifer K.

reviews.text: Needed a patio laid and some new planting to brighten up a shady corner. They listened to what we wanted, gave us a clear quote, and delivered exactly what we'd discussed. Quality work, no faffing about. Recommended them to our neighbours already.
reviews.author: David R.
